parsed.answer: Source 16472469 explicitly identifies pyridostatin (PDS) as a "G4-stabilizing compound" and notes that G-quadruplex-forming genomic sequences include telomeres, with PDS treatment increasing telomere fragility in BRCA2-deficient cells. This directly supports that pyridostatin stabilizes G-quadruplexes in the telomeric region. Source 58006489 (PGE2/bone homeostasis) is irrelevant to the claim.
